stem: Facility rooting success is 85%, but one donor/batch combination is 52% while all others exceed 90%. What is the best analytical approach?
choices: Remove the 52% group as an outlier automatically.
Preserve the facility metric but stratify the donor/batch subgroup because the aggregate masks a localized problem.
Average the failed subgroup with the best donor twice.
rationale: Preserve the facility metric but stratify the donor/batch subgroup because the aggregate masks a localized problem.
